requirement: The guest web app shall let a guest booking a seated event preview the actual view from their selected section in 3D.
remaining_work: Decide whether the 3D section view is in scope, and if so what produces it (an uploaded CAD model, a generated mesh or third-party imagery), which surfaces show it, and what the fallback is for a venue with no model.

requirement: The platform shall support system-assigned best-available seat allocation with deferred disclosure of the seat to the customer.
remaining_work: Decide the deferred disclosure model: when the seat is actually allocated (at sale or later), what the guest's entitlement says in the meantime, when the seat-level ticket or QR is issued, and whether the venue may reshuffle allocated seats before disclosure.

requirement: In a capacity-based best-available flow the customer shall select only a section and quantity, with exact seats assigned internally and the seat-level ticket/QR code released closer to the e
remaining_work: Decide the capacity-based purchase path: whether the order line carries a section and quantity rather than seat ids, when internal allocation runs, and what triggers the release of the seat-level ticket or QR.

requirement: Suites shall be sellable either as a private bulk-priced suite or as individual seats within the suite.
remaining_work: Decide whether a suite zone may also be sold seat by seat — and if so, what governs the switch (a flag on the zone, a per-performance override), how the bulk price and the per-seat price coexist, and what happens to unsold seats in a part-sold suite.

requirement: Held seats shall auto-release immediately if a payment attempt fails, so inventory is not held against an incomplete transaction.
remaining_work: Decide what a failed payment attempt does to the hold: release immediately, shorten the remaining lease, or leave the timer running — and whether a retry within the window recovers the same seats.

requirement: In the deferred model the sale shall be confirmed immediately on section and quantity while exact seats are assigned internally.
remaining_work: Same decision as the deferred model: whether an order line may carry section and quantity with no seat ids, and when the internal allocation writes the seats back to the order.

requirement: The Shift Templates & Policies screen shall capture the grace period.
remaining_work: Decide the grace period: the minutes after shift start within which a clock-in still counts as on time, whether it is a template field or a venue-wide staffing rule, and whether exceeding it marks lateness, blocks the shift open, or only reports.

requirement: The Shift Templates & Policies screen shall capture the applicable days and effective dates.
remaining_work: Decide whether ShiftTemplate gains daysOfWeek plus effectiveFrom/effectiveTo, or whether applicability is held on the rota pattern that instantiates it — and what happens to already-published assignments when the template's dates change.

requirement: The 'Shift Policy Settings' panel shall configure Max Shift Duration, Min Rest Between Shifts, Flexible Start Window, Late Arrival Threshold and Early Leave Threshold with their units.
remaining_work: Decide the minutes for Flexible Start Window, Late Arrival Threshold and Early Leave Threshold, and where they live - StaffingRules (venue scope) or ShiftTemplate (per template) - so AttendanceRecord.exception late/earlyLeave has a defined boundary.

requirement: The Staff Resource Profile shall provide an Actions menu, previous and next record navigation and a View Full Profile link.
remaining_work: Decide whether a detail screen carries previous/next record stepping at all, and if so how it is served under cursor pagination - a stable ordered key on the list read, or a client-held page of ids. Then add the component to screens/_components.yaml.

requirement: A staffing rule shall express Requirement Logic based on participant count, mapping participant bands 1-8, 9-16, 17-24, 25-32 and 33+ to 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 instructors with minimum level and a
remaining_work: Decide how ratio-based requirement logic is expressed: bands with headcount and minimum level on StaffingRules.minimumCover, or a ratio (onePer, minimumLevel) on ResourceRequirement. Then decide whether the ratio is evaluated at sale (capacity) or at roster (c

requirement: The Cost Breakdown donut chart shall split labour cost into Regular Pay, Overtime, Premium Shifts, Allowances and Other with a percentage and amount per slice and a total in the centre.
remaining_work: Decide the pay-component set (regular, overtime, premium/unsocial, allowances, other), whether it is a groupBy value on getLabourCost or a components[] array on LabourCostRow, and where the component rates come from - ShiftTemplate.hourlyRate and StaffingRules

requirement: The staffing requirement rules shall be 1 Ski Instructor per 8 participants, 1 Snowboard Instructor per 10 participants, 1 Group Assistant per 15 participants, 1 Customer Service per 200 vis
remaining_work: Decide the ratio rule shape - denominator (participants, visitors, zone), the per-position rate, rounding (always up), and whether a minimum floor such as 'Min 1 per Zone' is a separate rule or a floor on the same one. Place it on StaffingRules.minimumCover an

requirement: The guest booking site shall provide a horizontal near-term date picker with a full calendar fallback.
remaining_work: Decide whether the date picker gains a horizontal near-term variant, how many days it shows before the full calendar takes over, and whether the choice is per tenant or fixed.

requirement: Workshop add-ons shall be presented inline with theme or cuisine sub-selection that feeds directly into time-slot availability.
remaining_work: Decide whether an add-on carries a sub-option axis (theme, cuisine), whether that axis constrains resource or session availability, and how getAvailability is parameterised to honour it.

requirement: Performance capacity shall be editable individually or via multi-select bulk edit.
remaining_work: Decide whether performance capacity supports a multi-select bulk edit, what may be selected by (performance, date range, event, envelope), and whether the bulk change applies to envelope capacity, channel allocations or both.

requirement: Tickets shall support configurable ticket-level attributes such as minimum age and ID-proof requirements, for example an Emirates ID for UAE-resident tickets with format validation or photo
remaining_work: Decide the ID-document vocabulary a ticket may demand (Emirates ID, passport, PoD card, other), whether the number is format-validated and against what pattern, and whether an image is uploaded and where it is retained.

requirement: Guest and ID-proof attributes such as Emirates ID, passport and handicap/PoD documentation shall be configurable per ticket and per region rather than fixed system behavior.
remaining_work: Decide the guest and ID-proof attribute list (Emirates ID, passport, handicap/PoD documentation) as a configurable set on the entitlement template, and confirm region is the scope level that overrides it.

requirement: The system shall recommend merging under-sold adjacent time slots and notify affected guests of the time change.
remaining_work: Decide the under-sold threshold that triggers a merge recommendation, what counts as adjacent, whether the merge is advisory or automatic, and which notification template moves the affected guests.

requirement: The booking flow shall optionally start by asking for the number of guests, narrowing the calendar to only those dates and times with sufficient availability.
remaining_work: Decide whether the booking flow supports a party-size-first variant, whether it is a tenant or product setting, and add the quantity parameter that lets getAvailability return only dates and slots with enough remaining capacity.

requirement: The combo visual shall be able to present revenue columns with an attendance line, and sales with average ticket value.
remaining_work: Decide and add the combo visual type to DashboardTile.visualisation, including which series takes the secondary axis and how the two axes are scaled and labelled.

requirement: The matrix / pivot visual shall be able to present venue to product sales by month and channel by ticket type.
remaining_work: Decide and add the matrix/pivot visual type, including how row and column hierarchies, subtotals and expand/collapse are expressed in DashboardTile.parameters.

requirement: The scatter / bubble visual shall be able to present price versus conversion and attendance versus spend per guest.
remaining_work: Decide and add the scatter/bubble visual type, including which fields bind to x, y and bubble size and how a third dimension is encoded.

requirement: The narrative / insight text visual shall be able to state comparisons such as admissions being 12% above last Tuesday.
remaining_work: Decide and add the narrative/insight text visual type, including which comparisons it may generate (prior period, same day last week, target) and the sentence templates it uses.

requirement: The Sales & Channel dashboard shall use stacked bars, a funnel, a trend chart, a table and slicers.
remaining_work: Decide and add the funnel and the slicer/filter-control visual types, including the funnel's stage definition and how a slicer's selection scopes the other tiles on the page.

requirement: The Product & Pricing dashboard shall use bar charts, a treemap, a scatter plot and a waterfall.
remaining_work: Decide and add the treemap, scatter and waterfall visual types, including the treemap's size and colour fields and the waterfall's start, delta and total semantics.

requirement: The Capacity Model shall be selectable as Fixed Quantity, Ratio Based, Tiered (By Participants), Capacity Based or Custom Formula.
remaining_work: Decide the capacity-model enum (fixedQuantity, ratioBased, tiered, capacityBased, customFormula), the parameter shape each variant needs, and whether custom formulas are expressions or a closed rule set - the latter has security and testability consequences th

requirement: A Ratio Based capacity model shall be expressed as a staff-to-participant ratio, shown here as 1 instructor per 8 participants.
remaining_work: Decide where the ratio lives and in what units - one staff per N participants on ResourceRequirement, with rounding and a minimum floor - and keep it the same expression the staffing rule reads, so sale-time capacity and roster-time cover cannot disagree.

requirement: The Demand & Capacity Setup shall capture Participant Count Source, Min Participants and Max Participants, shown here as Booked Participants, 1 and 40.
remaining_work: Decide what the participant count is sourced from (booked participants, sold tickets, checked-in guests) and where min/max participants sit - on the experience, the session or the resource requirement - since the source determines whether capacity moves after

requirement: The screen shall show a Capacity Calculation live preview deriving the sellable capacity from participants, ratio, required and available instructors, shown here as 24, 1:8, 3, 5 and 40 Part
remaining_work: Once the ratio is decided, specify the read that returns derived sellable capacity for a session - its inputs (participants, ratio, qualified-and-free staff), whether it is a catalogue read or a resources read, and its caching, since it moves whenever a roster

requirement: The capacity screen shall display a validation message stating how many participants the session can accept based on available qualified instructors.
remaining_work: After MOM-5924, decide the message contract: whether the ceiling is returned as a field on the capacity read or as a 409 Problem when a sale would breach it, and what the operator is told when the ceiling drops because an instructor went sick.

requirement: The Ticket Product Directory shall provide a bulk 'Clone' action.
remaining_work: Decide how a bulk clone names its clones - a code pattern, a suffix or a per-row prompt - given cloneProduct requires a unique code per clone.

requirement: The Category Details panel shall capture Effective Dates for the category as a from date and a to date.
remaining_work: Decide whether a category is effective-dated in its own right or simply deactivated, and if dated, what happens to products filed under it after the end date.

requirement: The Content & Localization frame shall require a Short Description limited to 150 characters with a live character counter.
remaining_work: Decide whether short and long descriptions are separate fields on Product and fix each one's maximum length.

requirement: The Content & Localization frame shall capture guest Instructions limited to 500 characters.
remaining_work: Decide whether guest instructions sit on Product, on EntitlementTemplate or in the CMS content block, and fix the limit.

requirement: The attribute table shall show the columns Attribute Name, Data Type, Required, Unique, Searchable and Channel Visible.
remaining_work: Decide the per-attribute flag set the data-mask field-definition registry carries - at minimum whether unique, searchable and channel-visible are stored flags or deployment decisions.

requirement: The system shall support an 'Add-on Eligible' product attribute of data type Boolean.
remaining_work: Decide whether add-on eligibility is a stored flag on Product or is derived from the bundles and entitlement templates that already reference it.

requirement: The system shall support the attribute data types Number, Pick List, Boolean, Reference and Text.
remaining_work: Fix the data-mask attribute data-type enum, and in particular decide what a Reference type points at and how it is validated.

requirement: The template list shall show the columns Template Name, Type, Last Updated and Used By.
remaining_work: Decide whether a template records its own updatedAt and a derived used-by count, following subscription.Plan.subscriberCount as the precedent.

requirement: The Import tab shall list Recent Import Jobs with the columns File Name, Rows, Status, Created By and Date.
remaining_work: Decide whether CatalogueImportJob stores sourceRef, createdByPrincipalId and createdAt, following Product.createdByPrincipalId as the precedent.

requirement: The Open-Dated Ticket Setup shall set an Entitlement Conversion rule, including 'Use entitlements by date of use'.
remaining_work: Decide the entitlement conversion rule set - at minimum whether entitlements are consumed by date of use or at issue - and where it sits on EntitlementTemplate.

requirement: The Date Change Policy shall limit the number of date changes allowed per ticket.
remaining_work: Decide where the change count is held - on the order line or the entitlement - and what happens on the attempt that exceeds the cap.

requirement: The Multi-Day frame shall set a Use Pattern of either Consecutive or Non-Consecutive days.
remaining_work: Decide whether a consecutive-use flag sits on EntitlementTemplate and how it is enforced at scan time against entriesUsed and lastEntryAt.

requirement: The Multi-Day frame shall set how skipped days are treated, such as 'Skipped days are lost'.
remaining_work: Decide whether a skipped day is forfeited, rolled forward or extends validTo, and whether that choice is per template or per venue.

requirement: The Camp & Recurring-Day frame shall set a Start Date Rule, such as 'Guest selects start week'.
remaining_work: Decide the start-date rule vocabulary - fixed date, offset from purchase, or guest-selected week - and where the guest's choice is recorded.

requirement: The Camp & Recurring-Day frame shall set a Skipped Session Treatment, such as 'Skipped sessions are lost'.
remaining_work: Decide whether a missed camp session is forfeited, made up or refunded, and whether sessions are tracked individually rather than as an entry count.

requirement: The Variant Dimensions table shall show the columns Dimension Name, Affects Pricing, Affects Capacity and Status.
remaining_work: Decide whether a variant dimension can split capacity as well as price, and whether a dimension carries an active/retired status distinct from its variants.

requirement: The system shall support a 'Guest Category' variant dimension that affects both pricing and capacity.
remaining_work: Decide whether guest category draws on its own capacity envelope, or confirm capacity stays at performance and channel level only.

requirement: The system shall support an 'Admission Tier' variant dimension that affects both pricing and capacity.
remaining_work: Decide whether an admission tier holds a capacity allocation of its own or shares the performance envelope.

requirement: The system shall support a 'Service Level' variant dimension that affects both pricing and capacity.
remaining_work: Decide whether a service-level dimension is the existing fastTrackTier or a separate priced axis, and whether it may hold capacity - the contract currently says it may not.

requirement: The Property Combination Matrix shall provide an 'Add Combination' action.
remaining_work: Decide whether a combination can be added outside the axis product - and if not, how the screen's Add Combination maps onto editing the axes.

requirement: The system shall mark each property combination as Active, Disabled or Excluded, and show a legend for these states.
remaining_work: Decide whether an invalid combination is excluded before generation or generated and marked, and add the third state if it is the latter.

requirement: The Validity Rule Library shall provide a 'Clone' action for an existing validity rule.
remaining_work: Decide whether entitlement templates get a clone operation following copyPriceList, and what a clone does about the products that referenced the original.

requirement: The validity rule table shall show the columns Rule Name, Model, Status, Effective From, Effective To, Used By and Owner.
remaining_work: Decide whether EntitlementTemplate carries effectiveFrom/effectiveTo, a responsible owner and a derived used-by count, following Product.onSaleFrom and Product.responsibleDepartmentId.

requirement: The system shall track validity rule status as Active, Draft, Retired or Expired and show a legend of these states.
remaining_work: Decide the validity-rule status set and whether it gets its own entry in states/, or confirm that a boolean plus effective dating is enough.

requirement: The validity period shall set End Time Inclusivity, such as 'Inclusive (valid until the end time)'.
remaining_work: Decide whether validTo and validTimeWindows.to are inclusive or exclusive, and state it on the schema so validateAccess and the reporting replica agree.

requirement: The validity period shall set a DST Treatment such as 'Keep Local Time (Adjust duration)'.
remaining_work: Decide whether validity windows are wall-clock or absolute across a DST change, and whether the duration or the local time is preserved.

requirement: The Fixed & Variable Period frame shall show a worked Example Calculation of sale date and resulting expiry with timezone.
remaining_work: Decide whether a dry-run expiry calculation is an operation of its own or a client-side rendering of the template's fields, and fix the timezone it prints in.

requirement: The Date & Time Range frame shall support an 'Overnight Window' that ends the next day.
remaining_work: Decide how an overnight window is expressed - a next-day flag on validTimeWindows or a to-time greater than 24:00 - and which calendar day the entitlement is counted against.

requirement: The Weekday & Calendar Rules frame shall be organised into Configuration, Calendar Preview and Precedence tabs.
remaining_work: Decide the precedence between daysOfWeek, validTimeWindows and blackoutDates, following RefundPolicy.timeBands and ApprovalRule.order as the precedents.

requirement: The system shall provide a 'Manage Calendars' capability for maintaining holiday calendars.
remaining_work: Decide whether a named holiday calendar becomes a shared entity that blackoutDates references, and which contract owns it.

requirement: The First-Use Activation frame shall be organised into Configuration, Activation Events and Audit tabs.
remaining_work: Decide whether first-use activation emits its own event and stamps an activatedAt on the entitlement, distinct from the first access-validated scan.

requirement: The First-Use Activation frame shall provide a 'Manual Activation Allowed' toggle.
remaining_work: Decide whether manual activation is an operation on the entitlement, what permission it needs, and what it sets validFrom to.

requirement: The First-Use Activation frame shall provide a 'Requires Approval' toggle for manual activation.
remaining_work: Decide whether manual activation is added to ApprovalKind or handled under accessPermissionChange, and set the rule thresholds for it.

requirement: The system shall support Performance Entitlement of Single Performance, Selected Performances or Any Performance.
remaining_work: Decide how performance breadth is modelled - a validityKind value plus a performance list on the entitlement template - and what happens when a listed performance is cancelled.

requirement: The Number-of-Days Validity frame shall set a Use Pattern of Consecutive or Flexible (Non-Consecutive).
remaining_work: Decide whether a consecutive-use flag sits on EntitlementTemplate, and how a break in use is detected against entriesUsed and lastEntryAt.

requirement: The Number-of-Days Validity frame shall provide a 'Partial Day Counts as Full Day' option.
remaining_work: Decide the day-counting rule for number-of-days products - calendar-day consumption on first entry versus rolling 24 hours - and whether it is a per-template setting or a platform constant.

requirement: The Monthly & Annual Validity frame shall set a Renewal Overlap rule, such as 'Allow 30 days overlap'.
remaining_work: Decide whether an early renewal stacks onto the unexpired remainder or restarts the term, and the maximum overlap in days permitted.

requirement: The Dynamic Expiry Calculation frame shall provide a Formula Builder with Days, Hours, Months, If/Then and bracket operators.
remaining_work: Decide whether expiry becomes an expression language at all, and if so the operator set, grammar, precedence and where the expressions are stored and versioned.

requirement: The Formula Builder shall support conditional expiry expressions evaluated against guest attributes.
remaining_work: Decide which guest attributes may branch an expiry rule, and how a change of attribute after issue affects an already-issued entitlement.

requirement: The Formula Builder shall validate the entered expiry formula and indicate that it is valid.
remaining_work: Falls out of the expiry-formula decision - define what a valid expression is and which failures block a save.

requirement: The Dynamic Expiry Calculation frame shall set a Fallback Rule used when inputs are missing, such as 'Date of Issue + 30 Days'.
remaining_work: Decide the fallback expiry when a conditional rule's inputs are unavailable at issue, and whether issue is blocked instead.

requirement: The Dynamic Expiry Calculation frame shall list the Inputs Used by the formula, including GuestCategory, FirstUseDate, Venue and TicketType.
remaining_work: Decide the closed list of fields an expiry rule may read, and what happens when one is added or removed after rules exist.

requirement: The Dynamic Expiry Calculation frame shall show a plain-language Explanation Preview of the calculated expiry.
remaining_work: Decide the sentence template for an expiry explanation and which inputs it must name.

requirement: The system shall set an expiry for a granted ticket-level exception in days.
remaining_work: Decide whether a granted exception is a standing record, and if so its default and maximum lifetime and what happens to in-flight visits when it lapses.

requirement: The Timeslot Template shall capture a free-text Description.
remaining_work: Decide whether a session template carries a description, its maximum length, and whether it is multilingual like product descriptions (1.4.20).

requirement: The Timeslot Template shall set a Lead Time in minutes before a slot.
remaining_work: Decide whether lead time is a field distinct from the booking cutoff, what it measures from, and whether it is per template or per channel.

requirement: The Timeslot Template shall be applied to one or more attractions, shown as removable chips with an add control.
remaining_work: Decide whether a session template may target many attractions or is cloned per attraction, and how an edit propagates either way.

requirement: The Timeslot Template shall carry a Status and a Version number.
remaining_work: Decide whether session templates join the product versioning and lifecycle mechanism, and what a new template version means for performances already generated from it.

requirement: The system shall constrain generated slots by a Minimum Capacity.
remaining_work: Decide whether a minimum capacity is a generation constraint, a publication guard or both, and what happens to slots already below it.

requirement: The system shall support an Association Mode of Specific Performances, By Rule or All in Series.
remaining_work: Decide the association modes and, for 'By Rule', which predicate selects performances and when it is re-evaluated as new performances are generated.

requirement: The system shall set a Reservation Requirement of Not Required, Optional, Required or Deferred (Auto Assign Later).
remaining_work: Decide the four reservation modes and, for Deferred, when auto-assignment runs, what it assigns against, and what happens when it cannot.

requirement: The system shall provide a 'Waitlist Eligible' toggle per product or slot.
remaining_work: Decide where waitlist eligibility is held - product, variant or performance - and the default for products that say nothing.

requirement: The system shall set a Max Waitlist Size.
remaining_work: Decide whether the waitlist is capped, at what level the cap is configured, and what joinWaitlist returns once it is full.

requirement: The Redeemable Product Entitlement shall set whether substitution is allowed, for example 'Same Category Only'.
remaining_work: Decide whether a redeemable entitlement permits substitution, and if so what defines 'same category' - product category, price band or an explicit substitution set.

requirement: The frame shall set a Max Award per Referrer.
remaining_work: Decide the cap on awards per referrer, the period it resets over, and what a referral beyond the cap does - refused, unrewarded, or flagged for review.

requirement: The system shall record a 'Refund' consumption event that increments the balance back.
remaining_work: Decide whether a refund of a partly-used entitlement returns quantity to the balance or closes the entitlement, and reconcile the answer with states/entitlement-status.yaml.

requirement: The system shall define Missing Data Behavior when profile data is missing, such as 'Request Evidence & Review'.
remaining_work: Decide the Missing Data Behavior vocabulary (block sale / allow and flag / request evidence and review / defer to manual override), which is the default, and whether it is set per condition or per rule set.

requirement: The system shall support a Limit Scope of Per Order, Per Guest, Per Account, Per Household or Per Payment Instrument.
remaining_work: Decide the limit-scope vocabulary: whether perHousehold and perPaymentInstrument are in it, what resolves a household (wallet.shared_wallet kind=household is the only candidate) and what identifies a payment instrument across orders without storing a PAN.

requirement: The system shall display a configurable message when a purchase limit is reached.
remaining_work: Decide where a limit-reached message is authored (per rule, per channel or per tenant), whether it is localised through LocalisedText, and whether it replaces or supplements the Problem.detail the API returns.

requirement: The assignment rules shall cap the number of Max Transfers per ticket.
remaining_work: Decide whether a per-ticket transfer cap exists, its default, whether it counts surrendered transfers or only claimed ones, and where it is configured (EntitlementTemplate alongside isTransferable is the obvious home).

requirement: The Group Ticket Configuration shall set whether the group leader is included in the headcount and how the leader is priced.
remaining_work: Decide whether the group leader counts toward expectedSize/confirmedSize, and how the leader's place is priced (same as group, free, or a separate leader rate) - this changes both capacity and revenue.

requirement: The Family Ticket Configuration shall set the Age Calculation Date basis, such as 'On Visit Date'.
remaining_work: Fix the age calculation basis (visit/performance date, purchase date, or booking date) for age-gated products, and decide whether it is a platform constant or configurable per entitlement template.

requirement: The system shall allocate corporate quota By Department, By Employee or By Campaign.
remaining_work: Decide the allocation dimensions for a corporate ticket quota, whether they are exclusive or nestable, and which record holds the allocation (a new corporate allocation row, or InvitationCampaign extended with an org-unit dimension).

requirement: The Membership Lifecycle Rules frame shall be organised into Lifecycle, Renewal, Proration and Approvals tabs.
remaining_work: Decide whether membership upgrades/downgrades mid-term are prorated, on what basis (daily, monthly, unused-entitlement), and whether a proration credit goes to the wallet or the original tender.

requirement: The system shall suspend membership access 7 days after a failed payment.
remaining_work: Decide whether a failed recurring membership payment ever suspends access automatically, after how many days, and who owns that decision - payments.yaml currently reserves it as 'a staff decision with a name attached to it'.

requirement: The system shall cancel a membership on member request with effect at the end of term.
remaining_work: Decide whether member-initiated cancellation takes effect immediately or at end of term, whether the entitlement stays usable until expiry, and what refund (if any) the remaining term attracts.

requirement: The subscription shall set the level of Access During Grace, such as 'Limited Access'.
remaining_work: Decide the entitlement level during a renewal grace period (full / limited / none), what 'limited' means in access terms (entries, venues, benefits), and whether it is set per entitlement template or per tenant.

requirement: The Product Relationship Map shall render a node-and-edge graph of the root product and its related products.
remaining_work: Decide whether the dependency view is a graph, what a node is (product, variant or both), which of the thirteen dependency types are drawn as edges, and how deep the walk goes from the root before it is truncated.

requirement: The Guest View shall show the Next Eligible Use date for a multi-attraction product.
remaining_work: Decide whether a multi-attraction entitlement has a minimum interval between uses (per attraction or overall), its unit, and whether blackout dates and day-of-week patterns fold into the same computation.

requirement: The system shall set the donation Prompt Position in checkout, such as 'After Payment Section'.
remaining_work: Decide whether the checkout donation prompt's position is configurable, the positions offered (before/after the payment section, on the confirmation step), and whether it is set per channel or per tenant.

requirement: The system shall set the donation Default State, such as 'Not Selected'.
remaining_work: Decide the default state of the checkout donation prompt (pre-selected or not), whether it may differ by channel or jurisdiction, and record the consent rationale - a pre-ticked donation is an opt-out in several markets.

requirement: The system shall provide a 'Campaign Product Association' frame associating campaigns with products and audiences.
remaining_work: Decide the association model for a donation campaign: which targets it binds to (product, category, ticket type, membership, package), whether guest segments are in scope at all, and where the association rows live.

requirement: The Campaign Product Association frame shall be organised into Associations, Exclusions, Preview and Conflicts tabs.
remaining_work: Decide whether campaign-to-product associations carry exclusion lists, what a conflict between two overlapping campaigns on one product means, and whether the promotions precedence/StackingMode mechanism is reused or a donation-specific rule is written.

requirement: The Policy Hub shall show an 'Expiring Soon' policies KPI tile (shown as 9).
remaining_work: Decide whether a service policy carries an expiry or scheduled-review date, whether expiry withdraws the policy or only warns, and what the 'soon' window is before the tile counts it.

requirement: The system shall support a 'Group Policy' owned by Sales Ops.
remaining_work: Decide the service-policy register: the named policy set and, per policy, the owning department or role, version, status and effective date.

requirement: The system shall support a 'Corporate Policy' owned by Corporate Sales.
remaining_work: Same register decision: name the corporate service policy and its owning function, with version, status and effective date.

requirement: A service policy shall state its Service Mode Availability as Self-Service, Agent Assisted or Manager Only.
remaining_work: Decide the service-mode vocabulary (Self-Service | Agent Assisted | Manager Only) and how it maps onto the existing channel list and the supervisor-exception flag.

requirement: The Reschedule Rules frame shall be organised into General, Eligibility, Fees, Inventory and Preview tabs.
remaining_work: Agree the section/tab information architecture for the Reschedule Rules editor (General, Eligibility, Fees, Inventory, Preview) and bind each section to the contract view that fills it; one IA pass covers every frame on these boards.

requirement: The system shall set an Allowed Reschedule Window as a number of days before and after the booked date.
remaining_work: Decide how the reschedule window is expressed (offset days before/after the booked date) and which record configures it; the amendment policy rule builder is the natural home.

requirement: The Exchange Rules frame shall be organised into General, Eligibility, Fees, Fulfillment and Preview tabs.
remaining_work: Agree the section/tab information architecture for the Exchange Rules editor (General, Eligibility, Fees, Fulfillment, Preview) and bind each section to the contract view that fills it; one IA pass covers every frame on these boards.

requirement: The Upgrade Rules frame shall be organised into General, Eligibility, Fees, Benefits and AI Suggestions tabs.
